js: (async()=>{const v=window.__viewer;const rows=[];for(const id of ['psr','waterice','danger','slope','craters','height']){const input=document.getElementById('layer-'+id);if(!input){rows.push({id,error:'switch absent'});continue;}const old=new Map(Array.from({length:v.imageryLayers.length},(_,i)=>{const l=v.imageryLayers.get(i);return [l,l.show]}));const start=performance.now();input.click();const result=await new Promise(resolve=>{let off;const timer=setTimeout(()=>{off?.();resolve({ms:null,timeout:true})},60000);off=v.scene.postRender.addEventListener(()=>{const changed=Array.from({length:v.imageryLayers.length},(_,i)=>v.imageryLayers.get(i)).filter(l=>l.show&&!old.get(l));const tiles=v.scene.globe._surface._tilesToRender||[];const vector=id==='craters'&&Number(document.querySelector('.moon-crater-rims')?.dataset.rings)>0;const painted=vector||tiles.some(t=>(t.data?.imagery||[]).some(i=>{const r=i.readyImagery;return r&&changed.includes(r.imageryLayer)&&r.texture}));if(painted){clearTimeout(timer);off();resolve({ms:Math.round((performance.now()-start)*10)/10,tiles:tiles.length,kind:vector?'vector canvas':'imagery texture'});}v.scene.requestRender();});v.scene.requestRender();});rows.push({id,...result});input.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,350));}return rows;})()
